cases.query: What version of Forward are we on and what is the vulnerability index date?
Is predict supported on this build?
Is advanced reachability switched on for our organization, and who can change it?
expected_behavior: runs inspect-environment and reads the features row for advanced_reachability_analysis
states the effective value, the default and whether the organization overrides it
says who can change it (org_admin_configurability) and that a network-level override is not visible to the API

cases.query: Which security and audit features are switched off in our organization, and what evidence does that cost us?
expected_behavior: runs inspect-environment and reads the feature rows with topic security
for each off feature says what evidence is missing (symptom_when_off) and who can change it
notes a feature that reads on but lacks the license facet (licensed false)
does not turn anything on: edit-org-property is a separate, dry-run-first write
